info.description:
# Nyaatimer

Nyaatimer is a Python package that provides a simple and convenient way to measure the execution time of your functions. It uses the `time.perf_counter()` function to get the most accurate time measurement available for your platform. The package also uses the `rich` library to print the results in a visually appealing way.

## Installation

You can install Nyaatimer using pip:

`pip install nyaatimer`

## Usage

To use Nyaatimer, simply import the `nyaatimer` decorator and apply it to the functions you want to measure the execution time of. Here's an example:

`from nyaatimer import nyaatimer @nyaatimer def my_function(arg1, arg2):     # Your function code here`

When you call `my_function`, Nyaatimer will automatically measure the time it takes to execute and print the result using the `rich` library.

Here's a complete example using the code snippet you provided:

`from time import perf_counter from rich import print as rprint from nyaatimer import nyaatimer @nyaatimer def example_function(arg1, arg2):     # Your function code here     pass example_function("arg1_value", "arg2_value")`

This will output something like:

`Function example_function took 0.0001234 seconds Args=('arg1_value', 'arg2_value'), Kwargs={}`
